files.description: 28-page §170.315(b)(10) EHI Export Self-Attestation Document for Benchmark EHR (Denali 3.1). Contains export workflow instructions, data format specifications, list of 47 exportable data element types, and detailed field-level descriptions with database column names for each entity. Retrieved from Wayback Machine (Feb 2024 snapshot) because the live URL returns HTTP 403.

Bun TypeScript script that extracts structured export schema from the PDF using pdftotext. Parses all 47 entity definitions, their field lists, descriptions, attachment indicators, and billing flags into queryable JSON.

Extracted JSON schema containing all 47 export entities with 1146 total database-column-level field definitions, entity descriptions, attachment flags, billing-only indicators, and export constraint notes. Machine-queryable output of the enrichment script.
Documentation for the enrichment extraction: run commands, input/output boundaries, and known parsing limitations.
